properties.notes: Demolition of existing building(s) and redevelopment of the site to provide three buildings ranging from 2 to 10 storeys in height, providing a residential led mixed-use development containing 337 residential units (Use Class C3) and 1750 sq.m (GIA) of commercial floorspace (Use Classes A1, A2, A3, A4, B1 and D2) with associated ancillary development to include 19 car parking spaces, cycle parking,hard and soft landscaping and access roads
